_comment: MiniMax-H3-Image text -> image, or an edit of up to 16 pictures. ComfyUI API format (the shape
POST /prompt accepts), so this file is both the UI starting point and the thing automation
submits. Seeded to user/default/workflows/ordo/ by scripts/comfyui/boot.sh: repo-owned,
replaced on every boot. Edit it here, not in the UI.
Text to image as written. To edit, add LoadImage nodes and wire each IMAGE into node 4 as
images.image_1, images.image_2, ...; the prompt names them <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, ...
Width and height 0 take the size of image_1, or 2048x2048 without pictures.
The model is distilled: 6 steps, cfg 1, no negative prompt. It expects a detailed English
description of the whole image; a one-line prompt gives a plain result.
Requires ComfyUI >= v0.45.0 (services/comfyui pins COMFYUI_APP_REF) and the weight files
listed under the minimax-h3-image backend in services/image-gen/plugin.yaml.
Submit THROUGH the gate (http://comfyui-gate:8188/prompt), never straight to comfyui:8188:
the gate acquires GPU residency before the render starts. See services/gpu-gate/README.md.

inputs.prompt: A sunlit workshop bench seen from slightly above: a half-built wooden sailboat model on a cutting mat, brass clamps, curled pine shavings, a mug of coffee and a pencil sketch of the hull, warm late-afternoon light through a window on the left, shallow depth of field, photographic.
